summary: Lifeway Foods filed an 8-K reporting entry into an underwriting agreement with BTIG and selling stockholder Danone USA for a secondary public offering of 3,454,756 shares at $19.50 per share, plus a concurrent $5 million share repurchase by the company. The issuer receives no proceeds. Closing expected May 19, 2026. This is a routine shelf takedown with a small issuer repurchase; no control change, tender offer, or strategic event. Classify as Other.
